summary: Viewport rectangle size calculation (__thiscall): when the source bounding box a2 is non-null, stores its pointer into this+0x30 (this[12]), then computes one axis extent from a2[4] - a2[3] into this+0xC (this[3]) clamped to zero and the other axis extent from a2[2] - a2[1] into this+0x10 (this[4]) also clamped to zero; returns the second axis extent (or null when a2 is null or that axis is non-positive).

operations.description: Null gate on a2: when the source bounding box is null, no fields are written and the function returns null.
Store the source bounding-box pointer a2 into this+0x30 (this[12]).
Compute one axis extent as a2[4] - a2[3]; store 0 into this+0xC (this[3]) when the difference is non-positive, otherwise store the difference plus 1.
Compute the other axis extent as a2[2] - a2[1]; store 0 into this+0x10 (this[4], initialized to 0) when the difference is non-positive, otherwise store the difference plus 1.
Return value is null when a2 is null or when the a2[2] - a2[1] axis is non-positive; otherwise it is that axis extent plus 1. Static caller is ObjectNameComparison (0x00477280).

clean_pseudocode: int a = box[4] - box[3];             /* one axis */
int b = box[2] - box[1];             /* other axis */
unresolved: Which rectangle axis maps to a2[4]-a2[3] (width) versus a2[2]-a2[1] (height) is inferred from the existing analysis; the packet does not confirm the semantic labels of the two a2 indexes.
The owning viewport/layout class and the meaning of the returned extent to the caller are unidentified.
